The Snowflake Houston User Group gets together to share best practices and network with other Snowflake users and data enthusiasts in the local area. Whether you're just starting out with Snowflake, or are a veteran user, join our group. We’re always interested in hearing stories of how to use Snowflake to do more with your data, or solve mission critical business data issues. As a member you will be invited to attend upcoming user group events in your area and have access to special content.
